values.binNote: The wiki's 'Total' row is simply twice AkshanQ#FinalDamage (outgoing + return pass), not a separate bin row; the bin only defines the single-pass FinalDamage calculation.

values.meaning: bonus movement speed on champion hit
values.quote: {{sti|ms|{{as|20%|ms}}}} {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} that decays over 1 second

mechanics.claim: Enemies can be hit only once per pass of the boomerang (outgoing and return are separate passes).
mechanics.quote: Enemies can be hit only once per pass.

mechanics.claim: The boomerang homes back to Akshan after passing its original range and not hitting a target in the last 500 units, dealing a second, separate instance of damage.
mechanics.quote: Once the boomerang has passed its original range and has not hit a target in the last 500 units of travelling, it homes back to '''Akshan''' and applies the same effects to enemies hit.

mechanics.claim: Damage is calculated based on the caster's current stats at the moment of the hit, not at cast time.
mechanics.quote: This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's current stats and changes dynamically.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield only blocks one of the two hits (outgoing or return), not both.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block a single hit.

mechanics.claim: Non-champion targets (e.g. a dummy) take reduced damage.
The cooldown starts only after the boomerang returns to Akshan, not on cast.
